function_declarations.name: swap_item
function_declarations.description: Call this when the picker finds a damaged item but there are spares available in the bin. This will swap the item and update inventory.

function_declarations.name: abort_order
function_declarations.description: Call this when the picker finds a damaged item and there are NO spares left. This will abort the order.
